correctness.rationale: The actual weighted border polynomial identity gives rho(w)=1/2 exactly when P_w(lambda)=0, for a simple Perron root lambda in (1,2). The characteristic polynomial H_w=(x-2)sum_{j in borders}x^(j-1)+1 is monic and has constant coefficient ±1. Hence lambda is an algebraic unit and no positive power lambda^d can be rational: both lambda^d and its inverse would be rational algebraic integers, forcing lambda^d=1. One nonzero monomial cannot vanish; cancellation of exactly two nonzero monomials requires rational lambda^(ell-j). This proves the restricted equivalence, not the unrestricted conjecture. Independently compared weighted border derivative to prefix-automaton Perron frequencies for all 426 eligible binary words of lengths 4..8. Finite checks merely corroborate the proof.
